summary:
A complete creative guide and productization blueprint for the Perception Engineering cross-expert stacking workflows. Organized in 8 parts:

1. Arsenal overview of the 8 cross-expert workflows
2. Six detailed best-use-case scenarios with real examples
3. Five creative/non-obvious applications (reverse pitch decks, newsletter format, copy forensics service, workshops, lead magnets)
4. Four-tier product ladder: Free newsletter → $47-97 prompt pack library → $297-497 async course → $2,997-4,997 live cohort
5. 30-day launch sequence with daily action items
6. Positioning strategy using Sutherland's own perception framework
7. Conservative revenue projections ($11K/mo at scale)
8. Meta-insight connecting the product to the Parallax brand thesis
